Coram : SURYA KANT, UJJAL BHUYAN
Issue for Consideration The Judge who had convicted the appellant was transferred post conviction, before the appellant could be heard on the quantum of sentence and a new Judge was posted in his place. Appellant relying on Sections 353 and 354, Cr.P.C sought direction from the High Court to the the case, including on the question of conviction. High Court whether justified in dismissing the petition filed by the appellant and directing the new Presiding Officer to hear the appellant on the question of sentence and pass an appropriate order in terms of Section 235(2) of the Cr.P.C.
Decision Date : 01-10-2024 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 4080/2024 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
